cases.assertion: I005 RequestCurriculumGeneration resolves to Curriculum owner/command route and high-level generation-intent contract.
I068 ApproveCourseActivation resolves to Curriculum owner/command route and immutable decision-receipt-only contract.
I006 ActivateCurriculumVersion resolves to Curriculum owner/command route and sole-active-transition contract.
I007 RequestCourseRefresh resolves to Curriculum owner/command route and refresh-intent-only contract.
I027 GetCurriculum resolves to Curriculum owner/query route and immutable version-pinned read contract.
I029 GetCourseFreshness resolves to Curriculum owner/query route with explicit version-pinned FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN semantics.
I034 CurriculumDraftReady resolves to Curriculum owner/event route and post-durable-state draft-ready semantics.
I035 CurriculumActivated resolves to Curriculum owner/event route and post-I006-commit semantics.
Curriculum path cannot write LearningGoal canonical truth.
Curriculum path cannot write learner mastery/retention/transfer truth.
Curriculum path cannot own generic job lifecycle truth.
Curriculum path cannot write Documents/artifact-byte canonical truth.
Curriculum path cannot manufacture rights/licensing canonical truth.
Caller/Core/transport cannot directly write Curriculum semantic state.
ACTIVE CurriculumVersion bytes are immutable; successor/supersession is required for change.
Transport delivery metadata cannot become Curriculum event identity or semantic authority.
Same semantic operation identity plus same payload converges on the same generation result.
Same semantic operation identity plus different payload fails with canonical duplicate-operation conflict.
Repeated I005 generation intent deduplicates to one Curriculum-owned request identity.
Repeated I007 refresh intent deduplicates to one pinned refresh workflow intent.
Repeated I068 approval operation converges on the same immutable decision receipt without activation side effect.
Repeated successful I006 activation replay converges without a second activation transition or second semantic event.
Duplicate at-least-once I034/I035 event delivery is consumer-safe through stable event identity.
Restart replay uses durable semantic receipts/intents and does not introduce stacked semantic retry.
I005/I006 rejects stale expected LearningGoal version where the command binds a goal version.
Mutation rejects stale expected Curriculum version or active-pointer generation.
I006 rejects lifecycle state other than READY_FOR_ACTIVATION.
Failed activation preserves the prior active pointer/version and emits no I035.
Activation never edits prior ACTIVE immutable bytes in place.
Successful activation records exact supersession/predecessor lineage.
Concurrent activation attempts with stale expected state fail closed rather than last-write-wins.
I007 rejects or explicitly rebinds a stale pinned refresh base; it cannot silently refresh another active version.
Restart reconstruction of the same durable state yields the same deterministic lifecycle result.
Unknown required rights standing blocks activation; UNKNOWN never becomes ALLOWED.
Denied required rights standing blocks activation.
Missing required accessible alternative blocks activation.
Stale required source freshness blocks activation when policy requires current freshness.
Unknown source freshness remains UNKNOWN/blocked and never silently becomes FRESH.
Unresolved material source contradiction blocks activation.
Outdated validation report cannot authorize activation of a different/currently changed target.
Blocking validation result prevents activation.
Approval receipt with stale target/goal/validation context cannot be used for activation.
Unavailable required shared dependency yields explicit blocked/degraded standing rather than guessed success.
Curriculum semantic state mutation, operation receipt and owner outbox records commit atomically or not at all.
I005 stores only external generic-job reference/intent and never becomes generic job owner.
Transient timeout after durable intent leaves rediscoverable/reconcilable state rather than minting a second semantic request.
Lost wakeup plus restart rediscovers unfinished durable generation/refresh intent without depending on delivery metadata.
Ambiguous external response is reconciled from durable intent/reference state and cannot justify duplicate semantic request creation.
I034/I035 is staged only after the corresponding owner state commits; rollback leaves no authoritative event.
I027 returns the exact requested/pinned CurriculumVersion and never silently substitutes latest mutable state.
I029 with missing current evidence returns UNKNOWN/typed dependency standing, never FRESH.
I034 durable draft-ready event does not imply validation PASS, approval, activation, mastery or learner outcome.
I035 binds the exact committed active CurriculumVersion and supersession lineage.
I068 approval command cannot change active Curriculum state or stage I035.
I006 rejects activation when no admissible I068 approval receipt exists.
I006 rejects approval receipt bound to a different CurriculumVersion identity/version.
I006 rejects approval whose validation-report or LearningGoal binding is stale/mismatched.
I072 refresh acceptance cannot route directly to ACTIVE; activation still requires I068 then I006.
I005 high-level semantic request identity cannot be reused as I066 compiler-stage request identity.
Only a successful atomic I006 commit may stage authoritative I035 CurriculumActivated.
